# Discord Auth Starter

React with **[@robojs/auth](/docs/plugins/auth)** for Discord authentication.

<Cards>
  <Card href="/docs/plugins/auth" title="@robojs/auth" description="Authentication plugin." />
  <Card href="/docs/web-apps" title="Documentation" description="Getting started with Robo.js" />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template web-apps/discord-auth-ts
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Configure Discord OAuth in `.env`:

```bash
DISCORD_CLIENT_ID=your-client-id
DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET=your-client-secret
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```
